**Direction constraint, measured not inherited.** Routing review to scope.ts, for the GRACE glob language parseScopeGlob accepts (literals, *, ?, whole-segment **), widens * and ** and path normalize and darwin case. ? is incomparable: matchSimpleGlob treats ? as a regex quantifier; scope.ts treats ? as one non-slash character. Invalid syntax (braces, mid-segment **) never reaches an approved plan (scope.unsupported-glob). No archived Glob contains ?. Active is empty. So no already-approved plan's permitted set shrinks. The reverse (scope.ts adopting the regex copy) would make status and cursor stricter and flip preflight. That direction is forbidden.
